people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;
translations.bsb: And the leaders of Israel, the heads of their families, presented an offering. These men were the tribal leaders who had supervised the registration.
translations.kjv: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
